idea-plugin.name: Hunch
idea-plugin.description:
Every ML run, remembered: its code, config, environment, metrics and why. Your Hunch experiment journal, inside PyCharm.

  • The tree of runs, with each run's hypothesis, main metric and its curve, and your conclusion. It updates while runs train.
  • Run with Hunch: start any Python run configuration under Hunch, with a hypothesis.
  • Keep or drop a run and write its conclusion, right from the table.
  • Compare two runs, or a run with the one it came from, in the diff viewer: config, metrics and every changed file.
  • Milestones: save one when you find something worth remembering, then browse your runs milestone by milestone.

Needs Hunch 0.3 or newer in the project's interpreter: pip install sigmoid-hunch. Runs are plain files in .hunch/, and nothing leaves your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First release:

  • The Hunch tool window: the tree of runs and their details, keep, drop and conclusions.
  • Compare runs in the diff viewer.
  • Run with Hunch for Python run configurations.
  • Milestones: browse runs by milestone, and save new ones.
